name: 3.5 Tree and Venn Diagrams
_note: NOT READY TO PUSH — 4 of 10 questions authored as of 2026-08-10. The bank held NOTHING usable for this section, so every question is being written from scratch, and each carries inline SVG because MyOpenMath has no tree or Venn primitive. WRITTEN: slots 1, 2, 5, 6 (q31, q34, q32, q33). STILL TO AUTHOR: slots 3, 4, 7, 8, 9 and the pre-FRQ in slot 10 — their file_path values below are the intended names and those files DO NOT EXIST YET, so this manifest will not validate until they do. Design for the missing five: slot 3 reads a GIVEN tree with unequal branch probabilities (screening-test shape) and multiplies along paths; slot 4 takes a conditional off a Venn, restricting to one circle so the denominator is a region rather than the total; slot 7 is three draws without replacement, where the tree stops being drawable and the path product has to be trusted; slot 8 is set operations and complements on a Venn, including A-and-not-B, which has no formula and must be read off the picture; slot 9 asks for P(at least one) both the long way and by complement, on a tree, to show why the complement is the one worth learning. PRE-FRQ (slot 10): dropped category is DRAW THE STRUCTURE FIRST — students compute plausible-looking products without ever committing to a tree or a Venn, so nothing catches a mis-stated second-stage probability. That is distinct from all nine dropped categories already in use (see reference/pre-frq-template.md). Points below are provisional and must be re-split to exactly 100 once all ten exist. Chapter 3 has no FRQ for this section either, so the pre-FRQ will define the shape.

questions.title: Read Four Probabilities off a Venn Diagram - take the four region counts and produce a marginal, a joint, a union and a neither
Fill a Venn from Three Probabilities - recover all four region probabilities from P(A), P(B) and the overlap, then confirm they account for everyone
Read a Given Tree - multiply along each path of a two-stage tree with unequal branch probabilities and confirm the leaves sum to one
Conditional Probability off a Venn - restrict to one circle so the denominator is a region rather than the whole group
Two Draws Without Replacement on a Tree - fill the missing second-stage branch, multiply along a path, and add the paths that satisfy the event
With Replacement or Without - compute the same two-draw probability both ways and say which assumption makes the draws independent
Three Draws Without Replacement - the point where the tree stops being worth drawing and the path product has to carry the reasoning
Set Operations and Complements on a Venn - including A and not B, which has no formula and has to be read off the picture
At Least One, Two Ways - add every satisfying path, then get the same number by complement, and see why the complement is the one worth learning
Pre-FRQ Grade a Diagram Setup - a tree-or-Venn scenario with a grading checklist, where the student grades four sample responses against the rubric instead of writing one
